rows.en: That day… at the International Committee for Earth Defense, the halt of development of the R-series super weapons was passed unanimously…
Kuh… How careless of me… To be beaten in a place like this… Ugh… I let my guard down.
Giant Robo! Defeat the enemy!
Let's go! One-Seven, One-Eight!
Escort the transport helicopter and guide it to the Far East Base!
Defeat Gigant and all the Destron monsters!
Defeat Gigant, Kelbaan's forces and all the Destron monsters!
Defeat Gigant, Kelbaan's forces, all the Destron monsters and the Alien Vira!
Defeat Revived Gyeron!
The transport helicopter is destroyed
All allies are destroyed, or a Destron commander monster invades the base
The <c3>heroes</c>' Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
Good afternoon…
Welcome!
Um… This is who I am.
Huh? "Andromeda Yumecon Lease Co."?
We're a company that offers leases on the Yumecon.
Yumecon?
Yes, it's truly a dream computer, with infinite uses.
A dream computer?
For example…
I WANT TO EAT CURRY RICE…
Wh-what? Curry just came out!? Well, that's amazing…
Hee hee… With the Yumecon, any dream comes true.
Any dream?

Yes, of course!

From the look of it… your shop is rather old. Why not take the plunge and renovate?
Well, I'd need the money for that…
No need to worry…
I WANT 2 MILLION YEN IN CASH…
Whoa… It even has a cash service?

Yes. Borrow big, and pay it back on a 200-year loan!

The annual interest is just 0.1%… Your children, grandchildren, great-grandchildren… you only need to pay it off by the time of their grandchildren.

An easy-going loan spanning 200 years!
Why, that's practically free, isn't it?
Yes… Please, take this opportunity to sign the contract.
Ah… y-yes.
Whaaat!?
Oyassan… So you signed the contract?

Well, you two… there's no reason to turn down something this handy, is there?

Plus… I can keep using the old PC just as it is, so that's nice.
Right, I've decided!
Hanpen, what have you decided?

I would very much like to sign a lease contract too.

So, Mr. Tachibana, where might one rent this Yumecon?
No way!?
So, Oyassan… you went and signed the contract?
Hanpen, you've decided? Don't tell me…?

Oh yes, it's exactly what you think! I would very much like to sign a lease contract too.

So, Mr. Tachibana, where might one rent this Yumecon?
Let's see… It's a place called Andromeda Yumecon Lease Co.

Andromeda Yumecon Lease Co.?

There's no address or phone number written on it… All right, let's look into it!

The humans possessed by Yumecon sickness…

will soon come to hate even moving their own bodies. Since everything is taken care of with a single finger…
Spread the Yumecon throughout all of Japan! Stir up the humans' insatiable greed and let them fall into depravity, body and soul…
How's it going over there?
No good, no leads…
I see…

But… is it really true?

What Gavan said, that Fuuma is scheming something with the Yumecon…

Yeah…

Judging from Gavan's investigation, which found that this Andromeda Yumecon Lease Co. doesn't actually exist, it's definitely fishy! There must be something to it!
You're right… Shaider, I'll keep looking a little longer!
I'm counting on you…
Leave it to Annie!!

…!?

Fuuma? So they really are scheming something!
Subjugate!

…!?

It's an SOS from Annie!
Hmm… So this is the Yumecon's CAPTAIN system?
Whoa!
Den! What's wrong!? What happened? Are you all right?
Whew… That was close. But I'm fine.
What on earth happened?
Den, you pressed some weird button, didn't you?
No… I just got close to this Yumecon. Why on earth…?
Annie!!
Grr… Someone's interfering!? Go! Fushigi Beast Umiumi!!
So, what about the Yumecon?

Oh… It's completely back to normal!

Andromeda Yumecon Lease Co. swapped it for a new one…
In such a short time?
Everyone, get away from the Yumecon!
Sharivan… I've solved the mystery of why you were targeted! Look!
Isn't that Sharivan?

That's right! Sharivan's photo is programmed into this silicon board, along with photos of me and Shaider.

When we get near a Yumecon, it automatically sends word to Fuuma's base!
What!? Then it really is Fuuma's…?

Yeah…

By now… every household has a Yumecon. It's like we're on a wanted list, huh?
Damn… We'll find the factory that makes them and smash it!
But where is it?

uncertain: U09220: Chief Kitakura's line; who beat her (Alien Vira, next row) inferred.
U09225-U09227/U09230: デストロン坊心 read as デストロン怪人 ("Destron monsters"); ビラ画心 as ビラ星人.
U09230: [ja]/[ja] heavily garbled; read as [ja]/(基地)[ja]. "the base" is a guess.
U09241/U09248: the saleswoman's katakana commands to the Yumecon rendered in capitals.
U09258/U09262: ハンペンさん from [HERO4] rendered "Hanpen" (the nickname).
U09277: Hessler's cry 征伐 rendered "Subjugate!" as before.
U09279: キャプテンシステム kept as "CAPTAIN system" (the 1980s Japanese videotex service).

new_names.why: from glossary ウミウミ + 不思議獣 title
